===
packages:
  - 'apps/*'
  - 'libs/*'
  - 'libs/*/*'
  - 'libs/*/*/*'
  - '!dist/**'
allowBuilds:
  '@firebase/util': true
  '@nestjs/core': true
  '@openapitools/openapi-generator-cli': true
  '@parcel/watcher': true
  '@swc/core': true
  esbuild: true
  less: true
  lmdb: true
  msgpackr-extract: true
  nx: true
  protobufjs: true
  # unrs-resolver (via @storybook/test-runner's jest-resolve) ships a prebuilt
  # napi binary, so its build script is not needed.
  unrs-resolver: false
  # cypress remains a transitive dependency (via @nx/cypress, pulled in by
  # @nx/web/@nx/angular) even though we migrated off Cypress to Playwright. Its
  # postinstall downloads the Cypress binary, which we do not want — explicitly
  # skip it so pnpm does not fail with ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS in CI.
  cypress: false
